ms.promise:
Note to Milestone Reviewers:
・Project completion for final milestone took a while to some delay in the process. One of the main KPI of this proposal which is: "Have an official UGM student body."
・Officiation of the student body by the UGM Headmaster went through 3 (three) delays that took 3 - 4 months
・Officiation will finally take place this 28th of August 2024 in collaboration with the largest exchange in Indonesia, Indodax
・Exchanges in Indonesia differ from western counterparts where they are crucial government crypto and blockchain partners
・Proof of this event can be found in this publication here.

The output of the final milestone will be:
・Submit Project Closeout Report (PCR) on this project results & findings
・Create a Project Closeout Video (PCV)
・Proof of officiation of the student body in Gadjah Mada University
・Give presentation to the Challenge Team regarding the outcome of our project
